extracted.name: Grilled Salmon with Dill Sauce
extracted.description: Grilled salmon stays moist with a simple mayonnaise and dill sauce.
ingredient_lines: 1 tablespoon chopped fresh dill, or to taste
3 pinches brown sugar, or to taste
instruction_lines: Preheat the grill to medium heat and lightly oil the grate.
Mix mayonnaise, dill, mustard, and brown sugar in a bowl. Spread vegetable oil over salmon skin.
Grill salmon skin-side down on the preheated grill. Spread mayonnaise mixture over top of salmon and cook until salmon is easily flaked with a fork, 6 to 12 minutes.
